verdict.rationale: Bland exposes a broad programmatic surface. There is a Pathways API to create and manage pathways, and a CLI billed as managing your 'entire Bland account' (calls, pathways, phone numbers). An MCP server covers calls, texts, pathways, agents, analytics and evals, and even signup can start over a plain API call. Together these strongly suggest near-parity with the UI. missing for 10: explicit API-vs-UI parity statement, evidence of API coverage for testbed, knowledge, triggers and voice cloning, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), independent hands-on corroboration.
